translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Ŋei Edo Yesu Wane Pilat Kaitko Iwenka Arikoi

Kepe qae qaewo mosop ŋei ŋetne so Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Skribe, so Yuda ware ware ŋei so kaunsol korop eŋe ikopka lewage more don ma togolekoi. Eŋe Yesu metine mulap togoleŋo lukka more iwenka ari Pilat wane meteo birakakoi.
Pilat eŋe Yesu qesonkake, “Ge Yuda wane kepe wareware suaine me mida?” Yesu eŋe mainge rake, “Oo, mo yewa goŋom ramaine yale.”
Mosop ŋei ŋetne eŋe don qesat manerop qesatkakoi.
Ea wane Pilat eŋe koso qesonkake, “Ge don mane mi mainge raikene me? Ge detnom! Eŋe don qesat loutne rau geŋano sarimaike!”
Yesu eŋe eŋane don dere more koso mi mainge rake, Pilat eŋe oŋaine qaeke.
Pilatŋo Yesu Kibego Qekei Wane Rake
Aŋelo Loloŋon Loloŋon wane Naso, Pilat eŋe mulap ŋei mane qeliŋkamaŋke. Eŋe ŋei ŋerep edom Pilat eŋe mulap ŋei mane eŋetine oramaŋkoi, rokop qesonka eŋe simileene mogare so qeliŋkamaŋke.

Naso yewao, ŋei mane mulap urumgo metke, eŋetine Barabas. Eŋe ŋei kawali qe more kepe ware ware yuanka more, ŋei natne enguwi seukkoi, eŋerop mulap urumgo waketkoi. Ŋei magu yewa eŋano ŋine mane eŋetine Barabas.
Naso yewao ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe sari Pilat qesonka more, naso baŋem okanmaŋke, yale mulap ŋei mane qeliŋkayakane olatkoi.
Pilat eŋe qesonone rake, “Maine na Yuda wane kepe ware ware suaine iwa qeliŋkawe ŋinano sariake me mida?”
Eŋe detke, mosop ŋei ŋetne eŋe Yesu wane umat mane suaine mida, eŋe yaup dere worik okane more eŋane kaitko kine midaine ma wakone dongo birakakoi.
Mosop ŋei ŋetne, pris, eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu wetko ketket okane taleone more, Pilat wano rau, Barabas qeliŋkaki, eŋano sariakane rakoi.
Pilat eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu koso qesonone rake, “Ŋine ŋei iwa Yuda kepe ware ware oramami, ea wane na dalino okanikale?”
Eŋe mainge boka rakoi, “Eŋe kibego qeu!”
Pilatŋo qesononge, “Onoka sotwane? Eŋe umat dalino okange?” Eŋe zok manerop togoleka rakoi, “Eŋe kibeŋ qabego qeu!”

Pilatŋo ŋei ŋerep wetene ma peseakane Barabas qeliŋkaki eŋano ariki Yesu kawali ŋei magu eŋane meteo bira kaki edo qe rasu qolok qe qolok mau paki, kumunam seleineŋo dime more, masi kine kine korop okanka more ŋado kibego ma ari qekoi.
Kawali Ŋei Edo Yesu Isi Bela Qebela Okankakoi
Kawali ŋei edo Yesu kepe ware ware wane mat wane sen koto iwenka ari more eŋane magu kawali ŋei korop edorau arikoi.
Eŋe Yesu kepe ware ware takot birakakoi. Eŋe takot weŋemka so marok okolerop ea lewino motkoi.
Eŋe Yesu wano isi bela qebela okanka ewine kito rakoi, “Oo! Ge Yuda kepe ware ware suaine naso kiroroine ge waikene!”
Eŋe zoroŋŋo lewine qe more, sotkau pakiso wawetene qe more bakom isisine kitokoi.
Eŋe eŋane isi bela qebela don olatpi qoeki, takot weŋemka yewa kitoqokka more eŋine takot eaŋo biraka more kibego qekei wane iwenka arikoi.
Eŋe Yesu Kibago Qekoi

Eŋe dumao ari ŋei mane eŋetne Saimon, eŋe mat suaino wayakane sariki, eŋe maratka more sorinkau Yesu wane kibeŋ qesiŋka tewekki arikoi. Saimon eŋe Sairini matko ŋine sarike, eŋane gipoletkine Alekzander so Rupus. Saimon eŋe, kawali ŋei edo ma more, qebinkau Yesu wane kibeŋ tewekke.
Eŋe Yesu ma more kepe mane eŋetne Golgota yewa ma arikoi. Kepe eŋetne ea wane kine iwa yale, ‘Lewet Setnenane Kepe.’
Eŋe yewao Yesu qelaŋ qeakane ra more wain so qelaŋ qeqe wane kinin yewarop maingekoi. Ea manbi, Yesu eŋe mi neke.
Pakimo, eŋe kibego qe more takotine, laplapine so maloine yewa wezu qe more yuane damo qe amanagukoi.
Sakoka, 9 kilok, eŋe Yesu kibego qekoi.
Eŋe kibeŋ kutno kibi isi qesat don qe motkoi, “Yuda Wane Ware Ware Suaine.”
Eŋe kobu ŋei etke Yesu wane wazaino nat nat weneŋ kibego etkukoi.
Anutu wane papiao don mane iwa yale pamaike, ea wele wakonge, ‘Eŋe kobu ŋei eŋerop qekei.’
Ŋei ŋerep ari sari okane ka more, ebeene bonepke isi bela qebela okanka rakoi, “Ge Anutu Wane Bakom Urum kitopoke more, kaiwe karewe koso mane musele maikenane rakone.
Ea wane ge geŋone qesiŋnagu more kibego ŋine qelige qoe ket arinom!”
Mosop ŋei ŋetne so Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei eŋe yalewaka Yesu wano isi bela qebela don okanka more auye rakoi, “Eŋe ŋei ŋerep natne maine qesiŋonge, ŋo, eŋine maine mi qesiŋnagumaike!
Eŋe, Kristo, Israel wane kepe ware ware suaine. Eŋe kibego ŋine maine qoe ketki ŋene ka more malipkaikene.” Kobu ŋei etke ere weneŋ Yesurop etkukoi, ere yalewaka Yesu don qotkoine olatkoik.
Yesu Eŋe Seukke.
Oŋabango kepe korop panamane paki, ari kepe deine zingeki rarapwano 3 kilok okange.
Okangi, Yesu eŋe togoleka boka rake, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabaktani?” Don kine iwa yale, “Anutune, Anutune ge onoka wane qeliŋnanmaine?”
Ŋei ŋerep natne osino okorakoi, eŋe yewa dere more rakoi, “Detkau! Eŋe Elaiya oramaike.”

Ŋei mane eŋe biririke ari more wain dokune tabainerop ea laplapŋo qe muruge more kudupko pise more piino neakane qe dege more rake, “Tomaka kaŋem! Elaiya eŋe sari more makokka birakaki kesiake me mida!”
Yesu eŋe koso manerop togoleka boka more asuine saki, seukke.
Seukki laplap suaine Anutu Wane Bakom Urum kotino okorake, ea keuoka buntuk wiri sari ketki qela qoeke.
Kawali ŋei eŋane ware ware eŋe Yesu wane osino okorake, eŋe kaki seukki mo rake, “Welekakatne, iwa eŋe Anutu wane Gipole okanmaike.”
Ŋerep natne eŋe amaŋ okora kakoi. Eŋane keuo Maria Magdalena, so Salome so Maria mane, Yakobo ketkele orakoi, so Yosep erane nagaetne.
Sogino Yesu eŋe Galili metke, naso yewao ŋerep yewa ere Yesu qesiŋkakoik. So ŋerep natne eŋe Yesu weneŋ Yerusalem matko wakoi.
Yesu Wane Pareŋine Kezem Koto Motkoi

Rarapwano Yosep, Arimatea ŋine, eŋe sari more mi kaet okange, eŋe Pilat wano ari more Yesu wane pareŋine mayakane qesonkake. Yosep eŋe Yuda wane ware ware mane ewinerop. Eŋe Anutu wane qeli ewe zonom wakongi kayakane, ware ware gege tomaka geokange. Kaiwe yewao eŋe Qezareko met met wane bano nagapko kaiwe yewao ŋei ŋerep eŋe Qezareko met met ea wane kine kine maulukkoi. Eŋe qezareko urata mi makoi ea wane Yosep eŋe Pilat wano ari qesonkake.
Pilat eŋe ikke wie waki kito qokkaki, kawali ŋei ŋetne oraki sariki qesonka rake, “Welekatne Yesu mo seukike me mida?”
Eŋe kawali ŋei ŋetne eŋano ŋine dere more Yosep olale rake, “Ge maine pareŋine maikene.”

Yosep eŋe laplap mane libeka qoleke, yewao Yesu wane pareŋine makoke ket more kawetka more deŋesereo kezem koto motke. Lom yewa mo wesi weku suaine ea wano mau okorake. Paki, wesi suaine mane rodiŋkaki, ari aŋaone yewa kito won geke.
Maria Magdalena so Maria, Yosep wane nagaine ere ka more wareka metpik, Yosep eŋe Yesu deŋesereo dukkake.
